raw_subject: CRITICAL: Ransomware activity detected across multiple endpoints
raw_content: WannaCryptor.D file-coder activity was detected on DOMAIN-CONTROLLER-01 and is reported to be spreading laterally. ESET PROTECT correlated related detections on the following additional endpoints within the same 5-minute window: FINANCE-PC-09, FINANCE-PC-11, HR-WORKSTATION-04. Mitigation attempt on the primary endpoint failed; files are actively being encrypted.
